<?php
// email_service.php - JWT-authenticated email sending microservice
require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Firebase\JWT\JWT;
use Firebase\JWT\Key;
use Firebase\JWT\JWK;

class EmailServiceConfig {
    private $rsaPublicKey;
    private $hmacSecret;
    private $allowedAlgorithms;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->rsaPublicKey = file_get_contents(getenv('JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH') ?: '/etc/keys/jwt_rsa.pub');
        $this->hmacSecret = getenv('JWT_HMAC_SECRET') ?: null;
        $this->allowedAlgorithms = $this->resolveAlgorithms();
    }
    
    private function resolveAlgorithms(): array {
        $configured = getenv('JWT_ALGORITHMS');
        if ($configured !== false && strlen($configured) > 0) {
            return array_map('trim', explode(',', $configured));
        }
        // Default: only RSA algorithms when no HMAC secret is set
        if ($this->hmacSecret === null) {
            return ['RS256', 'RS384', 'RS512'];
        }
        return ['RS256', 'HS256'];
    }
    
    public function getPublicKey(): string {
        return $this->rsaPublicKey;
    }
    
    public function getHmacSecret(): ?string {
        return $this->hmacSecret;
    }
    
    public function getAllowedAlgorithms(): array {
        return $this->allowedAlgorithms;
    }
}

class JWTValidator {
    private $config;
    
    public function __construct(EmailServiceConfig $config) {
        $this->config = $config;
    }
    
    public function validate(string $token): ?object {
        $algorithms = $this->config->getAllowedAlgorithms();
        $keyMaterial = $this->resolveKeyForValidation($token, $algorithms);
        
        try {
            $decoded = JWT::decode($token, $keyMaterial);
            if (!isset($decoded->sub) || !isset($decoded->scope)) {
                return null;
            }
            if (!in_array('email:send', (array)$decoded->scope)) {
                return null;
            }
            return $decoded;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            error_log('JWT validation failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }
    
    private function resolveKeyForValidation(string $token, array $algorithms): Key {
        $header = $this->parseHeader($token);
        $alg = $header['alg'] ?? 'RS256';
        
        // Determine which key to use based on algorithm family
        if ($this->isSymmetricAlgorithm($alg)) {
            $secret = $this->config->getHmacSecret();
            if ($secret === null) {
                // Reject: no HMAC secret configured, cannot validate symmetric tokens
                throw new \RuntimeException('No HMAC secret configured for symmetric algorithm');
            }
            return new Key($secret, $alg);
        }
        
        return new Key($this->config->getPublicKey(), $alg);
    }
    
    private function isSymmetricAlgorithm(string $alg): bool {
        return in_array($alg, ['HS256', 'HS384', 'HS512']);
    }
    
    private function parseHeader(string $token): array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return [];
        }
        $header = json_decode(base64_decode(strtr($parts[0], '-_', '+/')), true);
        return is_array($header) ? $header : [];
    }
}

class EmailSender {
    private $validator;
    private $rateLimiter;
    
    public function __construct(JWTValidator $validator) {
        $this->validator = $validator;
        $this->rateLimiter = [];
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(): void {
        $authHeader = $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '';
        if (!preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i', $authHeader, $matches)) {
            $this->respond(401, ['error' => 'Missing or invalid Authorization header']);
            return;
        }
        
        $claims = $this->validator->validate($matches[1]);
        if ($claims === null) {
            $this->respond(403, ['error' => 'Invalid or insufficient token']);
            return;
        }
        
        $body = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        if (!$this->validateEmailPayload($body)) {
            $this->respond(400, ['error' => 'Invalid email payload']);
            return;
        }
        
        $result = $this->sendEmail($body, $claims->sub);
        $this->respond($result ? 200 : 500, [
            'status' => $result ? 'sent' : 'failed',
            'sender' => $claims->sub
        ]);
    }
    
    private function validateEmailPayload(?array $body): bool {
        if ($body === null) return false;
        $required = ['to', 'subject', 'body'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (!isset($body[$field]) || !is_string($body[$field])) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return filter_var($body['to'], FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false;
    }
    
    private function sendEmail(array $payload, string $sender): bool {
        $to = filter_var($payload['to'], FILTER_SANITIZE_EMAIL);
        // Strip any CR/LF from header-bound values to prevent header injection (CWE-93).
        $subject = str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', substr(strip_tags($payload['subject']), 0, 200));
        $message = htmlspecialchars($payload['body'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        // Validate/sanitize the sender used in the From header; reject if it is not a valid email
        // or contains header-injection characters.
        $fromCandidate = filter_var($sender, FILTER_SANITIZE_EMAIL);
        if (filter_var($fromCandidate, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) === false
            || preg_match('/[\r\n]/', $fromCandidate)) {
            return false;
        }
        $from = $fromCandidate;

        $headers = "From: " . $from . "\r\n";
        $headers .= "Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8\r\n";
        $headers .= "X-Mailer: SecureEmailService/2.1\r\n";
        
        return mail($to, $subject, $message, $headers);
    }
    
    private function respond(int $code, array $data): void {
        http_response_code($code);
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode($data);
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$config = new EmailServiceConfig();
$validator = new JWTValidator($config);
$service = new EmailSender($validator);
$service->handleRequest();
